sections.4-1-why-no-single-test-is-perfect: Har test kabhi bimari ko miss karta hai (false negative) aur kabhi ghalat positive aata hai (false positive). Is liye koi test perfect nahi.
sections.4-2-the-four-key-words-with-a-simple-exa: Sensitivity, specificity, SnNout aur SpPin ko 100 patients ki misaal se samjhein.
sections.4-3-likelihood-ratios-the-most-useful-nu: Likelihood ratio batata hai ke test ka nateeja bimari ke imkaan ko kitna badalta hai. Yeh sab se kaam ka number hai.
sections.4-4-pre-test-probability-why-context-cha: Test ka matlab history par depend karta hai. Jab history pehle hi kisi bimari ki taraf ishara kare to positive test zyada qeemti hota hai.
sections.4-5-test-clusters-and-clinical-predictio: Tests ko milana (cluster) aam taur par accuracy barhata hai, jaise '4 mein se 3 positive'.
sections.4-6-symptom-reproduction-versus-a-diagno: Dard wapas aana sirf sensitivity batata hai; diagnostic positive ka matlab test ki asal kasauti poori hona hai.
sections.4-7-imaging-what-physiotherapists-must-k: X-ray haddi ke liye, MRI disc, nerves aur cartilage ke liye. Imaging ki tabdeeliyan bina dard wale logon mein bhi hoti hain.
sections.4-8-questions-with-answers: Sawaal hal karein. High sensitivity wala test negative ho to bimari ka imkaan kam ho jata hai.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
